old_problem: The generic PCIe recipe did not identify OCP function/BDF/root-port targets, mandatory CE evidence, or whether the selected NIC path carried management, bonds, VLANs or test traffic.
disposition_reason: The OCP CE intent and non-disruptive oracle can be specified independently of actual slot numbers. ED-03 permits the live OCP/BDF/network map as runtime project configuration, while ED-16 requires an isolated path and controlled injection. A separate OOB observer plus Windows PCIe evidence and traffic/link health resolves the review without assuming any OCP function is non-management.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 31, DeepSeek fields, historical record 2435 and next pending row 32.
Kept every OCP slot/function distinct from general PCIe and OCP UCE coverage.
Required fresh mapping through endpoint and root port to Cscript coordinates.
Made interface/bond/route/VLAN continuity part of acceptance.
Did not execute injection, network changes or recovery.

test_case.test_name: OCP slot correctable PCIe error with connectivity protection
test_case.purpose: Inject one correctable PCIe event per approved OCP function while proving the NIC/device, network paths and system remain healthy.
required_package: PN, firmware, driver and interface/bond/route/VLAN inventory
Supported CE injector build and semantics
Windows PCIe CE, traffic/link and applicable management oracle
Independent OOB recovery and BIOS restoration
test_case.test_command: From an independent management path, snapshot OCP topology and networking, quiesce or authorize a bounded traffic window, and have the FAE inject one mapped root-port CE. Correlate the exact Cscript/Windows event with uninterrupted link, driver, routes/bonds/VLANs and controlled traffic, retain optional BMC/UEFI evidence and restore BIOS state.
test_case.expected_result: Each selected OCP function reports the intended correctable PCIe event; link, traffic, driver and host health remain unchanged, the fault light remains off, applicable management records agree and configuration returns to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact OCP target identity, PCIe CE proof and stable connectivity/device/service health for all approved functions. A generic corrected log, guessed port, agent disconnection, link retrain/down, device reset or severity escalation is not PASS.
safety_gate: Prove independent OOB access and identify all management/data dependencies.
Never inject an active production path without owner-approved quiesce/window.
Refresh topology before each single-function injection.
Abort on path loss, wrong target, reset, fatal event or configuration drift; no retry.
expected_evidence: Full CE transcript and Windows PCIe evidence
test_case.recovery: If connectivity or device health changes, stop immediately, preserve OOB evidence, recover only through the independent path, restore network and BIOS baseline, and verify every dependent service before further approval.
